Understands the shop drawing review and gains the ability to read and interpret the contractor's CPM schedule at a basic level. What you will do Contribute across the end-to-end software development lifecycle by translating client and business needs into technical designs; building and enhancing features, APIs, automation, developer tools, and platform capabilities; and supporting testing, release, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Use best-in-class, enterprise-approved AI coding tools to accelerate development, testing, debugging, and documentation while validating outputs and protecting information. Apply modern engineering practices, including source control, code review, reusable frameworks, automated testing, and CI/CD. Collaborate with engineers, architects, and product partners to solve problems and deliver secure, reliable solutions. Skills you will build Software engineering foundations: Create clean and maintainable code, data structures, APIs, version control, code review, technical documentation, and debugging. AI-enabled engineering: Providing effective context to AI tools, evaluating AI-generated code, recognizing limitations, maintaining human oversight, and using AI responsibly. Automated quality and secure delivery: Unit and integration testing, test automation, continuous integration and delivery, secure coding, and vulnerability management. Platform and reliability fundamentals: Reusable frameworks, cloud and container concepts, observability, performance, resilience, and standardized engineering workflows. Product and business acumen: Connecting technical work to client needs, financial services outcomes, risk, controls, and measurable value. Professional collaboration: Working in a cross-functional team, communicating technical decisions, giving and receiving feedback, and learning from experienced engineers. Impact you will have at BNY Contribute to the development of applications and features that support business and engineering needs. Help improve software quality by identifying issues, testing solutions, and supporting implementation. Support teams in delivering reliable, effective technology solutions through strong development practices. See how software development powers innovation at a global financial services leader. Why this could be a fit for you This role is a strong fit if you enjoy coding, problem-solving, and building technology solutions. You are interested in learning how applications are developed, tested, and implemented in a professional environment. You like working through technical challenges and improving how software performs. You are curious, collaborative, and excited to keep growing your software development skills. Analyst Program Our 24-month rotational Analyst Program is designed to set you up for success from day one. New joiners take part in a structured induction experience to help them assimilate into BNY, learn about the organization, connect with peers and leaders, and build the core skills needed to navigate their early career with confidence. From day one, analysts are immersed in BNY's collaborative and innovative culture through: Enterprise-wide onboarding and development programming, including an in person immersive induction experience, executive speaker series, skill development, and networking opportunities. Meaningful project work aligned to key business practices and platforms, providing hands-on experience, skill development, and real-world business impact. Structured mentorship and career support from managers, senior leaders, peer mentors, business stakeholders, and dedicated program managers. Exposure across practices, platforms, and teams, building a broad understanding of BNY's integrated business model. Professional, technical, and financial services training designed to strengthen business acumen and prepare participants for long-term career success. A premier early-career experience, backed by senior leadership and designed to develop the next generation of talent for BNY's global workforce. Program eligibility: Enrollment in a 4-year undergraduate degree program with a strong focus on business-related and/or technology-related majors preferred. Graduating in Dec 2026 or May 2027 (U.S.). Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 or better. Does not require sponsorship for employment visa status (now or in the future) in the country where applying.
